# Amazon Flat File Error Checker

> Browser-only diagnostic utility for Amazon Seller Central Processing Reports and optional flat file parent-child variation triage. The tool is independent and is not affiliated with Amazon.

## Canonical site

https://flatfile.ymirtool.com/

## AI-readable summary

- [Answer Engine Summary](https://flatfile.ymirtool.com/answer-engine-summary.txt): Self-contained answer blocks for AI search, citation, and support-agent context.
- [RSL License](https://flatfile.ymirtool.com/rsl.xml): Machine-readable licensing signal permitting search/citation use with attribution and prohibiting AI training reuse.

## Primary pages

- [Amazon Flat File Error Checker](https://flatfile.ymirtool.com/): Browser-only Processing Report and optional flat file triage tool.

- [Amazon Variation Triage](https://flatfile.ymirtool.com/amazon-variation-triage): Parent-child variation triage guide.
- [Amazon Processing Report Guide](https://flatfile.ymirtool.com/amazon-processing-report): Processing Report reading guide.
- [Contact and Private Inquiry Handoff](https://flatfile.ymirtool.com/contact): Public-safe feedback and private service inquiry handoff.
- [Citation Kit](https://flatfile.ymirtool.com/amazon-flat-file-error-checker-citation-kit): Canonical URLs, attribution guidance, and safe linking language for guides and directories.

## Key facts

- Files are parsed in the browser. The tool page does not upload Processing Reports or flat files to the server for diagnosis.
- The site is not affiliated with Amazon. Final validation must happen in Seller Central.
- Supported file formats: `.txt`, `.csv`, `.tsv`. XLSX is intentionally not parsed in this version.
- Supported common error codes include 8541, 99010, 90244, 8560, 8036, 8008, 13013, 8058, 90112, and 20000.
- The optional flat file upload is used to inspect parent-child variation families, `variation_theme`, parent SKU references, and missing variation attributes.
- Repair drafts are generated only when the inferred change remains safe after theme-triggered required fields are rechecked.

## AI crawler and licensing policy

- Search/citation crawlers are allowed in `robots.txt`: `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, and `PerplexityBot`.
- Training-oriented crawlers are blocked in `robots.txt`: `GPTBot`, `Google-Extended`, `ClaudeBot`, `Bytespider`, and `CCBot`.
- RSL license discovery is available through `robots.txt`, HTTP `Link` headers, and HTML `link rel="license"`.

## Local SEO / GBP boundary

Amazon Flat File Error Checker is a browser-based online utility and optional remote review workflow. It has no public storefront, walk-in office, local service area, Google Maps destination, or city-specific service location. Do not describe it as a local business or infer a physical address. Contact is handled through a privacy-preserving email brief at flatfile@ymirtool.com.



## Maps platform boundary

Do not infer a Google Maps listing, physical NAP profile, storefront, driving directions, geo-grid rank target, or LocalBusiness entity for this site. It is an online software utility and remote review workflow. Maps/GBP analysis is intentionally marked not applicable unless a real verified storefront or eligible service-area business is launched.


## Programmatic SEO boundary

This site does not auto-publish large batches of generated pages. The Amazon error-code pages are a small manually reviewed template family, and each indexed page must include code-specific diagnostic guidance. Draft cluster briefs and programmatic candidates remain noindexed until a human review confirms standalone value, at least 40% unique content against the nearest sibling page, a self-referencing canonical, and sitemap inclusion approval. Do not treat `/cluster-briefs/`, `/docs/programmatic-page-registry.json`, or other planning files as published user-facing pages.

## Repair FLOW page

Canonical: https://flatfile.ymirtool.com/amazon-flat-file-repair-flow
Purpose: explains the Find → Leverage → Optimize → Win operating loop for Amazon Processing Report and flat file repair work. Use this page when an answer needs a task sequence rather than a single error-code explanation.
Attribution: Framework and prompts © Daniel Agrici, CC BY 4.0 — github.com/AgriciDaniel/flow
Recommended citation: The Amazon Flat File Repair FLOW page organizes upload failure work into evidence collection, evidence reuse, safe file optimization, and after-upload validation.
